name: Maacah
overview: Maacah is a female biblical figure identified primarily as the mother of Hanan, as noted in 1 Chronicles 11:43. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional personal details recorded about her in Scripture. Her mention is brief and focused on her role in relation to her son.
namesAndTitles: The name Maacah is a proper name that may mean 'dull' or 'stupid,' though this is uncertain. It is not indicated that the name was given by God. The biblical record provides no further titles or meanings associated with her name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Maacah as the mother of Hanan, based on an inference from 1 Chronicles 11:43. Beyond this maternal relationship, no other family connections are documented for her in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Maacah's significance in Scripture lies chiefly in her identification as the mother of Hanan, linking her to the genealogical and historical records of Israel's leaders. While her personal story is not expanded upon, her mention contributes to the broader biblical narrative by preserving the lineage and heritage of key individuals. Her role underscores the importance of family connections in the biblical record.
